name: studio-routing-pl
description: Routing set for Phase 5.2: real-style Polish requests, some addressed to Studio by name and some not, each checked by the owner the host loaded (a Skill call or a read of its SKILL.md; reads_any also accepts a profile reference). A small task answered without loading its owner fails here even when the reply is useful: the set measures routing, not quality. no_skills marks the wrong side of a known collision.
